svg.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif
svg.title: Player Board — Dwarves
svg.desc: One per player. The character card top left, the five tracks up the middle, four cards of kit on the right, and the round's phases under the character. The mana track is an arcane subject and is the only thing on the board that takes the slip. Generated by tools/build-board.mjs from data/playerboard.json and data/components.json — do not edit. 297 x 210 mm at 8 units/mm, 3 mm bleed. The ink plate alone is the black-and-white edition.

g.text: Turn order passes to the left.
